A topic page explains one concept in my own words, with runnable code. This
sample splits a sentence on whitespace, a crude stand-in for a real tokenizer.

```{python}
text = "Models read text as tokens, not words."
tokens = text.split()
print(f"{len(tokens)} tokens: {tokens}")
```
